user.title: Set up OwlWatt
user.description: OwlWatt measures whether your solar produces what it was promised to. Choose how you want to set it up.

menu_options.no_account: I don't have an account yet

token.title: Connect to your OwlWatt account
token.description:
Paste the API token from your OwlWatt account settings.

Don't have one yet? Go to owlwatt.com -> Account Settings -> Home Assistant -> Create API token.

data_description.token: Paste the full token. It is shown only once when created at owlwatt.com.

no_account.title: Start your OwlWatt trial
no_account.description:
OwlWatt offers a 30-day free trial (credit card required). After you complete signup at owlwatt.com, return here and choose 'I have an OwlWatt account' to finish setup.

Opening owlwatt.com/ha in your browser...

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the OwlWatt cloud. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: That token wasn't accepted. Make sure you copied the entire token from owlwatt.com -> Account Settings -> Home Assistant.
error.rate_limited: Too many setup attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Something went wrong during setup. Please try again or contact support@owlwatt.com.
error.already_configured: This OwlWatt account is already connected to Home Assistant.

abort.already_configured: This OwlWatt account is already set up.
abort.external_setup: Complete signup at owlwatt.com, then come back and choose 'I have an OwlWatt account'.
